input: Repaint the living room accent wall gray

gold.taskTitle: Repaint Living Room Accent Wall Gray
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to repaint their living room accent wall in a shade of gray.

questions.title: Which specific shade of gray are you targeting?
questions.description: Understand the exact gray tone the user has in mind, such as light, charcoal, warm, or cool gray.

questions.title: What is the current color of the accent wall?
questions.description: Know the existing wall color to determine whether priming or extra coats will be needed.

questions.title: What are the approximate dimensions of the wall?
questions.description: Get the height and width of the wall to calculate how much paint to purchase.

questions.title: Have you already chosen a specific paint brand or product?
questions.description: Determine if the user has a preferred brand, finish type, or existing paint in mind.

questions.title: What paint finish do you want — matte, eggshell, or satin?
questions.description: Clarify the desired sheen level, which affects both appearance and durability.

questions.title: Do you have painting supplies already, or need to buy them?
questions.description: Find out if the user has rollers, brushes, tape, drop cloths, and primer on hand.

questions.title: What is your target date for completing this project?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or timeframe to help structure the planning and preparation steps.
